title: Colorado Revised Statutes, Title 39, Article 22 - Income Tax
source_id: C.R.S. tit. 39, art. 22 (Parts 1 - 57; withholding is a part of art. 22)
verified_how: Expanded the official CRS Annotated table of contents: 'Title 39. Taxation (ss 39-1-101 - 39-37-302)' > 'Specific Taxes (ss 39-20-101 - 39-37-302)' > 'Income Tax (Art. 22)' > 'Article 22. notes: Article 22 carries both the individual income tax and employer wage withholding. Colorado's flat rate and refund mechanics interact with the TABOR provisions (Colo. Const. art. X s 20 and C.R.S. tit. 24, art. 77).
